**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The Agreement imposes no non-solicitation, no-hire, or anti-inducement covenant on Northwind. I checked the likely homes for such a clause (General §30, Confidentiality §16, Customer Responsibilities §12) and ran term searches for "solicit", "induce", "employ", and "hire" — the only hit is §12.3, which works in our favour by expressly confirming that Customer has made **no** no-hire commitment and stays free to hire anyone responding to general recruitment.

This sits at the **preferred** position (no non-solicit on Customer), so there is nothing to narrow. The one personnel-adjacent restriction, §12.4 (Vendor shall not develop a competing analytics service), binds the Vendor rather than us and is outside this rule's direction.
